prompt: Create a square black-and-white motivational poster with a high-fashion editorial portrait. The right half of the canvas is dominated by a close-up frontal portrait of a serious young man, a handsome young Latino man in his 20s, with short dark curly hair, sharp eyebrows, trimmed stubble beard, neutral intense expression, direct eye contact, and a plain white crew-neck shirt. Use crisp studio lighting, realistic skin texture, high contrast monochrome photography, clean white background, and a cropped composition where the top of the hair and shoulders are partly cut off. On the left half, overlay huge condensed bold uppercase Spanish typography in five stacked lines, aligned left, spanning from near the top to near the lower third; the text should read SI PIENSAS QUE PUEDES HACERLO ENTONCES PUEDES. Make the type black, extremely tall and heavy, with tight line spacing, partially transparent or multiply-blended so the face subtly shows through where the letters cross into the portrait. At the bottom left, add a small spaced-out uppercase mantra in three lines reading CREE. ENFÓCATE. EJECUTA., then below it add a handwritten script signature-style phrase reading Sigue adelante. with a loose underline stroke. Keep the overall design minimalist, premium, motivational, and poster-like; no borders, no logos, no extra objects, no color.

promptZh: 创作一张正方形的黑白励志海报，采用高级时尚编辑风格的肖像。画布右半部分为一名严肃年轻男性的正面特写肖像，一位 20 多岁英俊的拉丁裔男性，留着深色短卷发，眉毛轮廓分明，修剪整齐的胡茬，表情严肃且专注，直视镜头，身穿简约白色圆领衫。采用清晰的影棚灯光、逼真的皮肤质感、高对比度黑白摄影、干净的白色背景，以及顶部头发和肩部略微裁切的构图。在左半部分，叠加巨大的压缩粗体大写西班牙语排版，分为五行堆叠，左对齐，从顶部附近延伸至下三分之一处；文字内容应为 SI PIENSAS QUE PUEDES HACERLO ENTONCES PUEDES。字体设为黑色，极高且厚重，行间距紧凑，采用部分透明或正片叠底混合模式，使字母覆盖在肖像上时能隐约透出面部轮廓。在左下角，添加三行间距较大的小号大写咒语，内容为 CREE. ENFÓCATE. EJECUTA.，下方再添加一行手写签名风格的短语 Sigue adelante.，并配以随意的下划线。整体设计保持极简、高级、励志且具有海报感；无边框、无 Logo、无多余物体、无色彩。
